The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} allows you to combine two ingredients. Through these combinations it's possible to create new products, though most combinations will yield only [[goo]]. In order to get access to the technology required to pursue alchemy you must agree to help [[Clotho]] recover her memory.
